name: rea-studio
description: Analyze an Electron app on your own machine and write a REA Studio project file.

scripts.preanalyze: npm run build --workspace=@rea-studio/schema && npm run build --workspace=@rea-studio/rea-adapter && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run preanalyze && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test dist-tests/tests/*.test.js
